job.title: Game Producer (R&D)
job.descriptionHtml:
We are Joyteractive - a leading mobile game developer and publisher specializing in the captivating world of puzzle games. Today, our team boasts 50+ rockstar professionals, and we're on the lookout for talented individuals to help us dominate the world of puzzles!

Our flagship game, Cryptogram: Word Brain Puzzle, consistently ranks in the top word puzzle games in the US:

🏆 #1 in the Cryptogram niche by downloads

✏️ #2-3 in Word Games

🧩 Top 10 Puzzle Games in the US for the last 6 months

We’re looking for an experienced Producer to join our R&D team.

What are you working on?

  • Genres: Puzzle, Casual

  • Platforms: Mobile, iOS, Android

For which tasks (responsibilities)?

  • Supervise one of the areas of product development

  • Conduct market research

  • Analyze product metrics

  • Based on this analysis, formulate product hypotheses and implement them together with the team

  • Develop a roadmap for the direction and be responsible for its execution from the product perspective

What kind of professional are we looking for?

  • Solid and successful experience in mobile gamedev as a Senior/Lead Game Designer, Producer/Product Manager; casual/puzzle games development is a plus

  • Solid knowledge of mobile games trends and features

  • Solid knowledge of game/product design

  • Strong analytical skills

  • Exceptional organizational and work structuring skills

  • Ability to analyze the market

  • Knowledge of monetization trends

  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher

  • Russian fluent

What are the conditions and bonuses?

For your success we offer:

🌴 18 business days of compensated day-offs

8 paid Personal Days a year + 1 day is added every year

👉 Flexible Public Holidays policy

❤️‍🩹 100% Sick Leave compensation

💻 Payment for wear and tear on equipment while using a personal computer

🌐 Remote work
